document: Quiet Ascent V2 -- public terms of the record
purpose: What can be verified WITHOUT any disclosure of the calculation rules. The claim supported here is about selection, not about the strategy.

relation_to_v1.shared_data: V1 and V2 are built from ONE vendor pull and ONE set of panels each month. Both repositories commit the identical attestations/attestation_YYYY-MM.json; the same body_sha256 appearing in both manifests is the proof.
relation_to_v1.cross_link: Every V2 manifest records the V1 public repository HEAD and V1's ledger chain value for the same month in lineage.v1_cross_link.
relation_to_v1.separate_chain: V2 has its own seed, anchor, ledger and key chain. The two chains are not interchangeable; a key from one opens nothing in the other.
relation_to_v1.account: The account that executed the V1 record through 2026-08 converted to the V2 book at the 2026-09-30 close. V1's record continues on paper from 2026-09; its manifests say so.

roster.fixed: The roster is fixed. A change to the set is a roster change and is logged here, in roster_changes, and in the next manifest's roster_changes, with a date and reason. Through 2026-09 the roster is one row, the traded book. From 2026-10 it is twelve rows, the V1 shape: three books by four treatments (roster_changes[0]).

rows.execution_basis: T MOC; legs below two whole shares as dollar-based orders in the final minutes

roster.licensed_tiers: The core and high-capacity tiers are published in the V2 documents whose fingerprints sit in every manifest's lineage.documents_sha256. For 2026-09 they are not sealed rows: that month's tier books are pinned indirectly, as a deterministic function of the attested inputs (attestations/attestation_2026-09.json), the engine hash and the configuration hash recorded in the manifest's lineage, which a reader with the engine can regenerate. From 2026-10 every tier and treatment is a sealed row, checkable by anyone with the released key.

roster_changes.to: 12 rows: {unrestricted, core, capacity} x {fully_invested, vol_managed_1.0, hedged_0.50, stacked}, the V1 roster shape. The traded row remains unrestricted.fully_invested; the eleven others are published-not-traded, as in V1.
roster_changes.reason: The licensed product is the tiers. A tier book pinned only through attested inputs and a pinned engine can be checked only by re-running the engine under NDA; a sealed row is checkable by anyone with the released key. The one-row roster was a scoping decision in the first build of the V2 chain (register 245-247) carried into these terms; the operator reversed it on the go-live morning, after the 2026-09 manifest had been sealed under the one-row roster. Not applied retroactively: 2026-09 stands as sealed.

cadence.book_fixed_at: the stamp session, one or more sessions BEFORE the month end; recorded per manifest as stamp_date

disclosure.sealed: Every committed book is sealed (AES-256-GCM) and its ciphertext is published with the manifest, so the book is fixed and handed over before its outcome is known.
disclosure.anchor: K_0 is published in commit_anchor.json, so any released key authenticates itself by hashing forward to it.
disclosure.monotonic: Keys form a reverse hash chain: releasing month m's key discloses month m and every earlier month, and cannot disclose a later one.
disclosure.rule: The key for month m is released when month m+19 is committed.

what_a_reader_can_check_today: the chain: each manifest's prev_manifest_sha256 and chain value against the previous manifest
the timestamp: the .ots proof for each manifest
the register: truncate PRE_REGISTRATION.md to lineage.pre_registration_v2.bytes and hash it
the data: the attestation's body_sha256 against the same file in the V1 repository
the envelope: sealed_sha256 against the published .seal.json bytes
what_requires_disclosure: the book itself: released keys open the sealed rows, and the plaintext hashes to book_sha256
not_in_this_file: Universe definition, feature set, screen clauses, exit gates, sizing model parameters and ladder depth are deliberately absent. Nothing here reveals more than a published manifest already does.
